_meta.purpose: Q-E2 counterexample for research/09: object-level feasibility does NOT imply embodied feasibility.
_meta.claim: The box's own start->goal path is collision-free, but no collision-free base+2R-arm config can touch the goal push-face (contact-support set empty): min reachable distance 1.46 > arm reach 1.20.
_meta.note: The 'robot' object uses the schema proposed in research/09b (not yet supported by any driver). Geometry (world/obstacles/box) IS consumable by validate_puzzle.py-style SAT tools.
